deep_dive.title: Coarse-to-Fine Domain Incremental Learning with Attentive Distillation for Mining Footprint Segmentation in Multispectral Imagery
deep_dive.abstract: Automatically mapping and segmenting global mining footprints using remote sensing and deep learning is critical for monitoring the socio-environmental risks and impacts of mining, yet its progress is hindered by the scarcity of fine-grained annotated data. Although large-scale datasets with coarse boundaries are widely available, leveraging them to improve fine-grained segmentation is challenging due to significant domain shift. To address this, we propose MineC2FNet, a coarse-to-fine domain incremental learning framework that exploits abundant coarse data to enhance fine-grained mining footprint segmentation. MineC2FNet adopts a teacher-student architecture with attentive distillation at both the feature and prediction levels, selectively transferring generalized knowledge from the coarse domain while enabling boundary refinement using limited fine-grained data (fine domain). We further introduce an expertly validated dataset of 219 images with precise boundary annotations across diverse geographies and commodities. Extensive experiments against state-of-the-art approaches, including domain adaptation and domain incremental learning methods, demonstrate that MineC2FNet achieves superior performance while effectively handling domain shift. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/risqiutama/MineC2FNet.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_en: domain incremental learning with attentive distillation prevents forgetting in mining segmentation

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Proposes MineC2FNet, a domain incremental learning method using attentive distillation to progressively integrate coarse-to-fine data for mining footprint segmentation, mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 矿业活动对环境具有深远影响，自动分割全球矿业足迹对于监控其社会-环境风险至关重要。然而，精细标注的像素级训练数据十分匮乏，而大量粗边界数据集虽易于获取，但利用它们提升细粒度分割性能面临显著的域偏移和灾难性遗忘问题。为解决这一挑战，本文提出MineC2FNet，一种从粗到细的领域增量学习框架，它采用教师-学生架构，通过多阶段注意力蒸馏技术，在逐步整合粗至细数据的过程中保留先前学到的知识。在多光谱遥感影像上的实验表明，该方法成功减轻了遗忘，实现了更高的分割准确率，为工业应用中利用低成本粗标注数据提供了可靠方案。

quick_skim.title: PANDO: Efficient Multimodal AI Agents via Online Skill Distillation
quick_skim.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal web agents often rely on increased inference-time computation, including rollout search, verifier passes, offline skill discovery, and specialist model stacks. This raises a central question: can a web agent become more efficient as it accumulates experience, rather than more expensive? We first analyze trajectories from VisualWebArena and identify three recurring sources of inefficiency: repeat-action loops, hidden discovery costs, and low prompt-cache reuse. We then introduce PANDO, a single-rollout online skill-distillation framework that maintains a structured Skill Library and combines progress reflection, confidence-based skill demotion, hierarchical routing, visual compression, and cache-aware prompting. On the full set of 910 VisualWebArena tasks, PANDO achieves a 58.3% success rate, outperforming SGV (54.0%) and our WALT reproduction (45.2%), while using 58% fewer tokens than SGV and 61% fewer tokens than WALT, without any pre-evaluation discovery budget. A 300-task ablation further shows that rules and routines provide most of the success gains, while routing, compression, and cache-aware prompting convert the larger skill library into lower marginal token cost. Finally, we introduce three trajectory-level efficiency metrics -- Action Repetition Rate, Step Overhead Ratio, and Prompt Cache Utilization -- to make efficiency visible beyond terminal success.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Online skill distillation enables agents to improve efficiency from accumulated experience, akin to self-improving AI.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_cn: 在线技能蒸馏使智能体从积累经验中提升效率，属于自我改进型 AI。

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: PANDO proposes an online skill-distillation framework with a structured Skill Library, enabling web agents to become more efficient over time by reusing skills from past experience, maintaining performance while reducing computation.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 现有网络智能体通常依赖大量推理时计算，难以从经验中持续提升效率。本文首先分析 VisualWebArena 轨迹，识别出重复动作循环、隐藏探索成本等低效来源。为此提出 PANDO 在线技能蒸馏框架，通过维护结构化的技能库，结合进度反思、信心降级、分层路由、视觉压缩等技术，实现单次推理的在线技能学习与复用。在完整 VisualWebArena 基准上，PANDO 在保持成功率的同时大幅降低计算开销，展示了通过经验积累持续提升智能体效率的可行路径。
